5. What is the IUPAC name of ethyl alcohol? Ans:- Ethanol is the IUPAC name of ethyl alcohol. 6. Write two examples of saturated hydrocarbons. Ans:- Methane and Ethane are two examples of saturated hydrocarbons. 7. What is trihydric alcohol? Ans:- The compound formed by replacing three hydrogen atoms of propane with three hydroxyl group is called trihydric alcohol which is also known as glycerine. 8. What is hydrocarbon? Give one example. Ans:- A hydrocarbon is an organic chemical compound composed only of the elements carbon (C) and hydrogen (H). The example of a hydrocarbon is Methane. 9. What is homologous series? Ans:- The series of hydrocarbons which can be represented by the same general formula is called a homologous series. 10. Define olefins with examples. Ans:- The hydrocarbons having double or triple covalent bond between the carbon atoms are called unsaturated hydrocarbon. They are more reactive so they are known as olefins. Alkene and alkyne are the example of olefins. 11. Name the hydrocarbon which is used to make chloroform. Ans:- The hydrocarbon used to make chloroform is Methane (CH4 ). 12. Give the name of the following compound. Ans:- Ethene is the name of the following compound. 13. What is the functional group? Give one example. Ans:- A functional group is a specific atom or a group of atoms within a molecule that is responsible for the characteristic chemical properties and reactions of that molecule. Hydroxyl group (-OH) is a example of functional group. 14. Name the alcohol which is used to make formaldehyde. Ans:- The alcohol used to make formaldehyde is Methanol (CH3OH) which is also commonly known as methyl alcohol. 15. What type of hydrocarbons are called paraffins. Ans:- The hydrocarbons having a single covalent bond between the carbon atoms are called Saturday hydrocarbons. They are less reactive so they are known as paraffin.
